tool_input.command: & '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -c "open('generated.txt','w').write('GENERATED_BY_PYTHON')"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $content = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '.\generated.txt'; if ($content -cne 'GENERATED_BY_PYTHON') { throw "Verification failed: '$content'" }; Write-Output $content
